terms.definition: The practice of bringing financial accountability and cross-functional cost management to AI workloads.
Operational controls and practices for measuring, governing, and optimizing token-based AI consumption.
A provider-metered text or other supported input unit sent to a model; exact counting and billing rules are provider-specific.
A provider-metered generated unit; provider definitions and rates vary by model and product.
A provider or application mechanism for reusing eligible prompt content; behavior, eligibility, and pricing depend on implementation.
Assigning shared or direct costs to the teams, products, or workloads responsible for consumption.
Cost and value measured against a consistent unit of workload or successful outcome.
Shared names and meanings for telemetry attributes and metrics, maintained as part of a specification.
